subject: part
title: PART.------TR.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-12 — the section on the accelerated division between black-creativity's affinity-insight-1 principle and the black community after bebop's emergence. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'the accelerated division between black creativity of the affinity insight (1) principle and the black community could be seen forming after the emergence of bebop — having to do with the misinformation that would accompany this continuum.' The crossing diagrams how participation structurally meets transformation in that division: PART (participation — actual participation in black creativity) crossed with TR (transformation — the receiving partner-axis that converts participation into transformation). PART sits on the left with the subject-arrow; POL-SIGN (political significance) rises from the main line to the upper-right, and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branches from POL-SIGN. TR is partner-axis at center-right. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) descends from the main line to the lower-right, and AF-TD (affinity tendencies) branches from PROG-CONT. RES-RT (responsibility ratio) descends from the main line on the lower-left, with INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) branching from it.
